info.title: Marketly API
info.description:
Design of the Marketly marketplace API: Customer Store (website + Android app), Seller Center, Admin Center and Operations. One backend, organised in removable modules. Generated from docs/api/spec/*.json.

- **Store API** `/api/store/{module}`: Customers and guests on the website and the Android app. Every request carries a token: a visitor token (guests, issued when the app opens) or a customer access token.
- **Seller API** `/api/seller/{module}`: Seller owners and seller staff in Seller Center (website + Android app). Seller member session. Every request acts for one seller account; seller member permissions apply.
- **Admin API** `/api/admin/{module}`: Internal staff in the Admin Center and Operations Center. Staff session. Role permissions and approval limits apply.
- **Public API** `/api/public/{module}`: Anyone (sign-in, registration, public settings). Visitor token of any app. Refresh and sign-out take the refresh token; the bootstrap endpoint takes an app proof.
- **Webhooks** `/webhooks/{module}`: Payment, carrier and email providers. Provider signature header, verified per provider

tags.name: Store API · Advertising
tags.description: Ad placements and their rules, ad campaigns through the full lifecycle, creatives and their review, audiences, schedules, frequency caps and dismissal suppression, rotation and priority, the serving decision for each page view, display/click/dismissal tracking with attribution, and seller sponsored campaigns with spending limits and ad charges kept separate from commission.

tags.name: Store API · Cart
tags.description: One cart across the Official Store and marketplace sellers for customers and guests. Every line is bound to the exact offer the customer chose, lines are grouped into seller packages with delivery estimates and shipping, and every read re-checks price, stock and eligibility so changes are explained per item instead of discarding the cart.

tags.name: Store API · Catalog
tags.description: What a product is: categories, attributes, brands, products, variants, and the review workflow that decides whether a product may be sold. How a seller sells it (price, stock, condition) belongs to offers.

tags.name: Store API · Checkout
tags.description: Turns a cart (or a Buy now offer) into an accepted order: identify the customer or guest, choose an address with a per-item shippability check, pick delivery options per package, apply coupons or credit with reasons and item coverage, choose payment, review sellers, return terms and totals, revalidate into a change set the customer must accept, and place the order idempotently with clear payment results.

tags.name: Store API · Content
tags.description: Store content managed by the Content Manager: ordered and scheduled homepage sections, campaign pages and curated collections, Help Center articles and categories, policies with versions and effective dates, the About page and footer links. Every item has an owner, a preview, a publication status and schedule, a version history with restore, and a correction or removal action.

tags.name: Store API · Customers
tags.description: The customer side of an account: profile, saved addresses, marketing consent, recently viewed products, the Account tab overview, guest order access, data export and account closure, and the staff view of customer accounts with notes and recorded account actions. Credentials, sessions and verification belong to identity.

tags.name: Store API · Identity
tags.description: Who someone is and how they prove it: accounts for customers, seller members and staff, credentials, email verification, sessions and refresh tokens for the website and the Android app, password recovery, 2-step verification, signed-in devices, guest sessions and the security activity log.

tags.name: Store API · Media
tags.description: Every uploaded or generated file: images, video and documents. Signed direct uploads, scanning and processing, renditions, alt text, ownership (seller, staff, customer, platform), image standard checks, where each file is used, and the rules for deleting, removing and retaining files (files in use or kept as evidence cannot be deleted).

tags.name: Store API · Messaging
tags.description: Private service conversations linked to an order, item, return or case: customer with seller (or the Official Store), which Marketly support can join from a case, with attachments, read state, seller reply targets and overdue flags, and staff moderation. No promotional messages.

tags.name: Store API · Notifications
tags.description: Who is told what, on which channel: notification topics for customers, sellers and staff, routing from platform events to recipients (staff by role, with backups), templates with versions and preview, in-app inboxes for the store, Seller Center and Admin Center, email delivery with retries and suppression, seller and staff channel preferences, promotional broadcasts under consent, and Android push devices (phase 3).

tags.name: Store API · Offers
tags.description: How one seller (or the Official Store) sells one variant in one condition: price and authentic was-price, purchase limit, seller SKU, dispatch, shipping profile, return and warranty terms, offer status, and the published featured-offer rule that picks the main offer for a delivery location.

tags.name: Store API · Orders
tags.description: The accepted purchase: one order per checkout, one seller group per seller package, and items with their own state (Confirmed, Preparing, Delayed, Shipped, Delivered, cancellation, return, refund). Keeps frozen purchase snapshots, derives the overall status from the items, tracks payment, delivery and returns progress separately, and runs item-level cancellations, seller fulfillment tasks with dispatch deadlines, timelines and purchase documents.

tags.name: Store API · Payments
tags.description: Charging customers through provider adapters (card, digital wallet): payment intents per checkout attempt, authorization and capture per order and seller group, declines with retry, uncertain results resolved by a status-check job, refund execution (Requested → Processing → Sent / Failed) capped at the remaining refundable amount, chargebacks and payment disputes, saved payment methods and provider webhooks.

tags.name: Store API · Promotions
tags.description: Discounts and sales campaigns: markdowns, percentage and fixed coupons, minimum-spend and free-shipping offers, flash sales, seller discounts and platform campaigns with seller consent. Owns eligibility, stacking, budgets and caps, the funding owner of every discount, coupon clipping and redemption, the Deals page data and campaign results.

tags.name: Store API · Reports
tags.description: Business reporting with stated meanings: metric definitions with a named owner and versions, a report catalogue grouped by business area, report queries with an explicit date basis, currency and time zone, the admin and seller dashboards, and authorized export jobs. All figures come from read models fed by other modules' events, never from their tables.

tags.name: Store API · Returns
tags.description: Return policies (platform baseline, seller terms, category exceptions, who pays return shipping), per-item eligibility, return requests and decisions, return shipments, receipt and inspection, remedies (refund, replacement, exchange) and the refund request that Finance approves before payments sends the money.

tags.name: Store API · Reviews
tags.description: Product reviews (Verified Purchase), seller feedback kept separate from product reviews, public seller responses under rules, product questions and answers labelled by who answered, reports of inappropriate content, moderation with outcomes visible to reporter and author, appeals, and rating summaries for products and sellers.

tags.name: Store API · Search
tags.description: Finding products: a product index built from catalog, offers, inventory and reviews events; search with misspelling tolerance and corrections, suggestions (queries, categories, brands, stores, products, recent searches), universal and category filters with counts, sorting, sponsored slots from advertising, and guidance for empty or unavailable results.

tags.name: Store API · Sellers
tags.description: Seller admission and the seller account: the Sell with us programme and multi-step application, verification checks and review decisions, seller statuses with account status, product approval and payout readiness kept separate, setup and launch readiness, storefront profile and public storefront, seller members and permissions, performance against targets, warnings, restrictions, suspensions and appeals.

tags.name: Store API · Shipping
tags.description: How things get delivered: carriers and services, destinations and excluded areas, shipping profiles with rates (Official Store and sellers), free-shipping rules, dispatch targets and cutoffs, the holiday and service-interruption calendar, delivery estimates for a location, shipments with contents and tracking, labels where supported, partial shipments, and delivery exceptions with their required responses and carrier claims.

tags.name: Store API · Support
tags.description: Help cases and disputes: customer help and order-problem cases opened from the order with items pre-identified, seller support requests to Marketly, disputes between customer and seller with evidence, decision, remedy and appeal, plus categories, priority, owner, SLA deadlines, assignment, escalation and resolve/reopen rules.

tags.name: Store API · Trust and risk
tags.description: Trust and Risk's case file: reports of counterfeit goods, suspicious orders, fake reviews and abuse from customers, sellers, staff, brand owners and automated signals, with evidence, a risk score, an investigation workflow, enforcement recommendations routed to the team that owns the action, recorded enforcement with reasons, and appeals decided by someone other than the original decider. Trust recommends; Catalog, Seller Manager, Support, Finance and the other owners act.

tags.name: Store API · Wallet
tags.description: Customer store credit with an auditable ledger (refunds to credit, goodwill credit within approval limits, price adjustments, use at checkout, expiry), gift cards, and a placeholder for loyalty rewards. Checkout and payments use the balance through the in-process public API.

tags.name: Store API · Wishlist
tags.description: Saved shopping for customers: saved items in one or more lists, price-drop and back-in-stock alerts, and shareable lists. Alerts are delivered through notifications under the customer's promotional preferences.

tags.name: Seller API · Advertising
tags.description: Ad placements and their rules, ad campaigns through the full lifecycle, creatives and their review, audiences, schedules, frequency caps and dismissal suppression, rotation and priority, the serving decision for each page view, display/click/dismissal tracking with attribution, and seller sponsored campaigns with spending limits and ad charges kept separate from commission.

tags.name: Seller API · Action history
tags.description: The tamper-evident action history: who did what, in which role, to which record, why, what changed (before and after), which approvals applied and the request id. Every module writes to it through record(); staff read it with filters and authorized exports; retention is a governed setting.

tags.name: Seller API · Catalog

tags.name: Seller API · Finance

tags.name: Seller API · Fulfillment service
tags.description: Platform storage and shipping for sellers: seller enrollment under service terms, SKU enrollment, inbound shipments to our warehouse, receiving into seller-owned stock, picking and shipping by us while the seller stays the seller of record, returns handling, removal of stock, and storage and handling fees with full seller visibility.

tags.name: Seller API · Identity

tags.name: Seller API · Inventory
tags.description: How many units exist and in which stock group: stock items per offer/SKU with Available, Reserved, Incoming, Damaged or held and Returned quantities per location, checkout holds and order allocations, an append-only movement ledger, reasoned adjustments with second review, low-stock alerts, receipt confirmation and return stock outcomes.

get.summary: Roles with people, lead, backups and approval-limit summary
get.description:
Small and bounded (about 25 roles), not paged.

**Permission:** `access.roles.view`

**Screens:** admin/staff

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: Fields are missing or invalid. details.issues lists each field.

put.summary: Replace the permissions of a role
put.description:
Removing permissions and adding ones that are not sensitive apply at once. Adding sensitive permissions (sensitivePermissionPrefixes), or adding any permission to a role the caller holds or to the Business Owner role, is saved pending approval (access.roles.sensitive-grant; the Business Owner decides for the caller's own role and the Business Owner role): the answer is the normal 200 with RoleDetail.pendingPermissionApproval (FORMAT.md, Approval responses), and the permissions are added when the request is approved. A newer proposal for the same role cancels the waiting one. Permissions never include approval limits; those are set with POST /limit-changes.

**Permission:** `access.roles.manage`

**Step-up:** 2-step code in X-Step-Up-Code (purpose `role-grant`)

**Approval:** Approval action access.roles.sensitive-grant. Sensitive permissions need a second reviewer; the caller's own role and the Business Owner role need the Business Owner

**Audited:** recorded in the action history.

**Publishes:** `access.role.changed`, `access.approval.requested`

**Screens:** admin/staff

put.description:
Lengthening applies now. Shortening is saved as pendingChange and sent to the Business Owner (approval action audit.retention.change): the normal 200 with pendingChange.approval (FORMAT.md, Approval responses); it applies when approved and is dropped when rejected, cancelled or expired. When access answers allowed for the caller, it applies at once. APPROVAL_REQUIRED (409, nothing saved) only while the access module is disabled, so no approval can be requested; FORBIDDEN when the caller may not even propose it. While a shortening waits, no other retention change is accepted (ILLEGAL_TRANSITION).

**Permission:** `audit.retention.manage`

**Approval:** Approval action audit.retention.change. Shortening retention needs Business Owner approval

post.summary: Merge the guest cart into the customer cart after sign-in
post.description:
Send with the customer session and the guest session id in the body. Proof of ownership: the account must have claimed that guest session at sign-in or registration (identity.guest_session.claimed, recorded by cart's consumer); knowing the id is not enough, and an unclaimed or unknown session answers NOT_FOUND. Normally the merge has already happened through that event; this call returns its report (or merges now if the event has not arrived yet). Same offer: quantities combine up to the limit. Different offer for the same variant: both lines kept. Unavailable guest lines are dropped with a note; guest lines beyond maxLines are dropped too (outcome dropped_unavailable, note 'Your cart is full'). The guest's saved-for-later items move to the customer in the same transaction (owner_kind customer, customer_id set, guest_session_id cleared; when the customer already saved that offer the customer's row is kept and the guest row deleted). Idempotent by guest cart: a second call returns the same report.

**Publishes:** `cart.cart.merged`

**Screens:** auth/sign-in, store/cart, store/checkout

post.summary: Place the order and pay
post.description:
Requires an Idempotency-Key; the same key returns the first result, and while a session is placing, pending or completed any further call returns the current result without a new charge. Steps: lock; check quoteVersion and expectedTotal; revalidate (changes → changes_required, nothing charged); hold stock (inventory.hold); reserve promotions; hold store credit (wallet.holdCredit; INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT when the balance dropped below the amount applied); read content.currentPolicyVersions(['returns', 'shipping', 'purchase_terms']) (the versions accepted with this order); authorize (payments.authorize); then accepted → order created and accepted (confirmation); pending → order created with payment checking (payment-result page, no second payment); failed → no order, cart and choices kept, holds kept until retryUntil; requires_action → bank challenge. Before authorizing, the session's attempt count is checked against maxPaymentAttempts (PAYMENT_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED); editing the checkout never resets it, so edit → place cannot bypass the limit. createOrder gets the real authorize result as paymentState (accepted creates the order open in one step) and the session's attemptNo. A new card's providerToken is used for this authorize only and cleared from payment_selection afterwards, whatever the outcome.

**Idempotent:** send an Idempotency-Key.

**Publishes:** `checkout.session.completed`, `checkout.changes.detected`

**Screens:** store/checkout, store/payment-result, store/confirmation, store/checkout-review-changes

Owner step: needs the permission content.policies.approve and the caller must be the policy's owner (or hold content.policies.manage). access.check on the approval action content.policies.approve only decides who finishes: allowed (the caller is the Business Owner) approves in one step; approval_required or denied raises the Business Owner's final approval with access.requestApproval and the version stays in_review until access.approval.decided. post.summary: Apply an account action with a recorded reason
post.description:
send_password_reset and sign_out_everywhere call identity and need customers.accounts.security. Restrict, suspend, reinstate and close need customers.accounts.act and go through the account status machine. Restricting or closing stops new orders; existing orders, returns, refunds and cases stay open and reachable. Closing an account with open obligations needs a second reviewer (access approval request).

**Permission:** `customers.accounts.act`

**Approval:** Approval action customers.accounts.close-with-obligations. Closing an account that still has open orders, returns or cases needs a second reviewer

**Audited:** recorded in the action history.

**Publishes:** `customers.account.status_changed`, `customers.account.restricted`

**Screens:** admin/customers

Within the caller's price-change limit the change is applied or scheduled; above it, it becomes an approval request in access and is applied only after approval. New price applies to new orders only; open carts see the change before checkout.

**Permission:** `offers.official.price`

**Approval:** Approval action offers.prices.change. Changes larger than the caller's price-change limit (access approval limits; example: Official Store Manager ±30%) need Business Owner approval before going live

**Audited:** recorded in the action history.

**Publishes:** `offers.offer.price_changed`

post.summary: Issue a refund from the order page (exception refund request)
post.description:
Admin 'Issue refund' dialog on admin/order. Items and amounts of one seller group, reason and funding; the dialog shows the cap from payments (GET /api/admin/payments/orders/{orderId}/refundable, in-process payments.remainingRefundable) and amounts above it return REFUND_EXCEEDS_REFUNDABLE. Creates a refund request with source exception that goes through Finance approval like any other; within the caller's limit it is approved in the same call and handed to payments. Optional trustReportId links it to a trust recommendation. Above the caller's limit it is saved under review and the response (201) carries `approval` (FORMAT.md, Approval responses). VALIDATION_FAILED also when the items belong to more than one seller group; NOT_FOUND for an unknown order; REMEDY_NOT_AVAILABLE for store credit while wallet is off or for a guest order.

**Permission:** `returns.exceptions.propose`

**Approval:** Approval action returns.refunds.approve. Within the caller's refund limit it is approved at once; above it a Finance member whose limit covers it, and a second reviewer above that limit's threshold, approve through access

**Idempotent:** send an Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Accept the agreements and submit
post.description:
Records each agreement version with the typed signature, creates the seller row (status applied), starts automated verification checks and sets the decision target. Duplicate checks run in the same call: the tax id hash, payout token, business and return address and work email are matched against other applications and sellers (including closed ones); every match is added to duplicateSignals and sent to trust with trust.raiseSignal (type duplicate_application, subjects the application and the matched seller, dedupeKey per application) when trust is enabled. sellers.application.submitted carries the hashes for trust's own rules. Fails with APPLICATION_INCOMPLETE (details.missing per step) or AGREEMENT_VERSION_OUTDATED if a newer version became effective while the applicant was reading.

**Publishes:** `sellers.application.submitted`, `sellers.agreement.accepted`

**Screens:** sell/apply

post.summary: Restrict a seller (reason, affected activity, scope, appeal route, review date)
post.description:
Above the caller's authority (access: Recommend only / Permitted with second review) the restriction is saved as pending_approval with an access approval request and the call answers 201 with the Restriction and its approval (ApprovalInfo); it becomes active on access.approval.decided (approved). It never answers APPROVAL_REQUIRED. Active restrictions publish sellers.seller.restricted; offers, promotions and advertising stop only the affected activity. Existing orders, returns, cases and messages keep working.

**Permission:** `sellers.accounts.restrict`

**Approval:** Approval action sellers.sellers.restrict. Second reviewer when the caller's role is 'Permitted with second review' for seller restrictions

post.summary: Record the decision and remedy, publish the appeal deadline to both parties
post.description:
Refund remedies create a refund request in returns (Finance approves within limits; approved is not sent). Goodwill credit needs the wallet module (GOODWILL_UNAVAILABLE while it is off, decision D-RT3); goodwill above the decider's limit needs approval through wallet and access. A guest has no wallet: their goodwill becomes a platform-funded partial refund through returns. Remedies left without items (goodwill, refunds) default to the case's items. A replacement is created by returns (returns.requestReplacement): it attaches to the case's open return when that return covers the item, otherwise it is a replacement without a return; REPLACEMENT_NEEDS_RETURN while the returns module is off. notifyParties=false still records and shows the decision but sends no email (notified=false). Platform-funded remedies above the decider's limit: the decision is saved pending (cases.approval_request_id) and the call answers 200 with AdminCaseDetail.pendingApproval; nothing is published until access.approval.decided. APPROVAL_REQUIRED (409, nothing saved) only while an earlier decision on the case still waits for approval.

**Permission:** `support.disputes.decide`

**Approval:** Approval action support.remedies.approve. Platform-funded remedies above the decider's limit (e.g. $50) are saved pending and go to Finance through access (200 with pendingApproval); goodwill credit is checked by wallet.goodwill.grant

**Idempotent:** send an Idempotency-Key.

**Audited:** recorded in the action history.

**Publishes:** `support.case.decided`

**Screens:** admin/case

post.summary: Owner team accepts (records enforcement) or declines with a reason
post.description:
Accept checks the owner's own permission for the action through access (e.g. catalog.products.publish, sellers.accounts.restrict, customers.accounts.act, finance.holds.place) and its approval limit; above the limit the accept is sent for approval: the recommendation stays sent_to_owner with approvalRequestId and the call answers 200 with `approval` (ApprovalInfo); access.approval.decided (approved) accepts it as the requester. Accept records an Enforcement and publishes trust.enforcement.recorded, which the owning module executes. Actions no module executes (hold_payout, hold_dispatch, review_payments, refund_buyers, inform_customers, revoke_claim, request_identity_confirmation, other) are done in the owning module's screen first (e.g. Finance places the hold in admin/finance with the trustReportId) and accepted with externalRef; without it the accept is refused with EXTERNAL_REF_REQUIRED (alreadyApplied=true in the event so nobody executes it twice). Their enforcement is applied when the owning module's confirming event arrives (see the Enforcement execution machine) or at once when nothing can confirm it.

**Permission:** `trust.recommendations.decide`

**Audited:** recorded in the action history.

**Publishes:** `trust.recommendation.decided`, `trust.enforcement.recorded`

**Screens:** admin/trust, admin/catalog, admin/seller, admin/cases, admin/finance

externalRef.description: Required to accept an action no module executes: the record created in the owning module (hold id, approval ref, case ref, claim id)

regions.description: Service regions, e.g. CA, OR, WA

categoryIds.description: Interest from browsing in this store only, when privacy choices allow

pages.description: Page types (see notes) within the placement's eligible pages

customerId.description: customer: the customers-module id (preferred over accountId; never an account id). notifications resolves the identity account and email through customers.getCustomer, so modules that only know an order's customerId (shipping, returns, payments) address the customer directly instead of the order email

sellerId.description: seller: all members who should get this topic; seller_member: one member

roleKey.description: staff_role: resolved through access (lead, or covering backup)

kind.description: order, order_item, shipment, return, refund, case, conversation, product, seller_order, payout, statement, hold, restriction, approval, queue, setting_change, account, campaign

label.description: Button text, e.g. Open dispatch queue

screen.description: App route / prototype screen id (design/prototype catalogue), the screen where the publishing module shows the record (its endpoint screens), e.g. account/tracking, seller/order, ops/dispatch. Invitation emails carry url and use accept-invitation (identity lists no screen for it)

context.description: Template variables, e.g. { order: { ref }, seller: { name }, package: { label, items } }

dedupeKey.description: Same key + recipient within dedupeWindowMinutes is sent once; also used by resolve and cancelScheduled

coveringFor.description: Name of the away lead when received as backup

recipients.description: Who receives the notice now for this role, e.g. Theo Grant (lead); from notice_recipients

group.description: Inbox filter: customer orders|returns_refunds|cases|account|promotions; seller orders|returns_cases|products|account_finance; staff = work area

icon.description: Icon name from the design system, e.g. truck

state.description: Action notices only (null for information notices): open; resolved = the work was done; expired = no longer needed (the record closed another way or the notice aged out), shown as 'No longer needed', never as Resolved

total.description: All notices in the inbox (read and unread), for the All chip

totalByGroup.description: All notices per group (read and unread), for the category chips, e.g. Returns & cases 4

needsAction.description: Open action notices sorted by deadline, max 10

routingToday.description: Roles the caller leads, backs up or covers, and who receives their notices today (from access)

available.description: False until the channel's phase (SMS 2, push 3)

locked.description: In-app for essential topics is always on

required.description: e.g. the link variable: every notice must link to its record

key.description: customer.shipment.dispatched, seller.dispatch.reminder, staff.approval.waiting…

audience.description: external: suppliers and rights owners, by email only

opens.description: What the link opens: Order details, Tracking, Seller order, Payout record…

staffRoleKeys.description: Staff topics: roles it is routed to

sellerPermission.description: Seller topics: members need this permission to receive it

ownerOnly.description: Seller topics only for the owner (payouts and holds)

frequencyLabel.description: Promotional topics: how often it is sent, e.g. Weekly, Monthly; null for event-driven topics

external.description: Email-only topics for contacts outside Marketly (suppliers, rights owners)

body.description: Plain text with {{variables}}; email HTML is rendered from the layout

audience.description: external: email templates for suppliers and rights owners

otherChannels.description: Same topic in other channels (Email / In-app tabs)

footer.description: Essential: 'You can't unsubscribe from order updates…'; promotional: unsubscribe line

subject.description: Rendered subject (bodies are not stored; sensitive topics store no subject variables)

groups.description: Topic group key → receives (new_orders, dispatch_overdue, returns_cases, customer_messages, payouts_holds, products, promotions)

lockedGroups.description: Owner: essential groups always on; staff: owner-only groups cannot be enabled

essential.description: Always on, in the account and by email

emailByArea.description: Work area → also send by email (in-app is always on)

dailyDigest.description: One summary email at the start of business hours instead of individual emails for non-urgent notices

filters.description: Audience filters, e.g. { customersSince: date, purchasedCategories: uuid[] } or { sellerCategories: uuid[] }

title.description: Product title with the variant label (e.g. 'Aurora Headphones – Black'), copied from catalog when the offer is created and kept current from catalog.product.updated / catalog.product.merged. Used for admin and seller title search and by modules that list offers without catalog (shipping profile usage).

conditionNotes.description: Required for used and refurbished; shown beside the price

includedItems.description: What is in this seller's box (defaults to the product's included items)

missingItems.description: Product's standard included items that this offer does not include. Must be stated; shown as 'Missing: …'

missingItemsStale.description: True when the product's box changed (catalog.product.updated) and missingItems names items no longer in it, or no longer lists everything absent. The seller is asked to review (offers.offer.missing_items_stale); cleared when the seller saves missingItems again. The offer stays on sale meanwhile.

sellerSku.description: Seller's own code; customers do not see it

stockItemId.description: inventory stock item that holds this offer's quantities

publishOnApproval.description: Draft on a product still in catalog review goes live when the product is approved

termsVersion.description: Increments on any customer-visible change; carts compare it to detect changes

basis.description: lowest_30_days: this offer's lowest price in the 30 days before the sale; list_price: manufacturer list price on file

verified.description: Checked against price history or the list price on file. Unverified was-prices are never shown.

explanation.description: e.g. 'Was price is the Official Store's lowest price in the 30 days before the sale.'

sameDayCutoff.description: Local cutoff HH:mm for same-day dispatch, market time zone

shipsFrom.description: City and region, e.g. 'Reno, NV'. Official Store offers: the inventory default location (inventory.getDefaultLocation), set at save and refreshed by the hourly offers.reevaluate-eligibility job when that location changes (inventory publishes no location event; the refresh does not bump termsVersion); seller offers: the seller's ships-from address from shipping seller settings. Never empty: falls back to the market default location label (kernel config).

kind.description: extended = more generous than the platform baseline for the category

categoryException.description: Category exception text shown before purchase: returns' summary when resolveTerms answered source category_exception at save (column return_category_exception); null otherwise

summary.description: e.g. '30-day returns. You pay return shipping unless the item is faulty.'

policyVersion.description: returns policy version (EffectiveTerms.policyVersion, e.g. '1.0') the terms were validated against at save; null when returns was off

message.description: Customer-safe text, e.g. 'Not eligible for featured offer: delivery performance under review'

affectedActivity.description: For restrictions: what is stopped, e.g. 'Refurbished offers and new listings'

appealRoute.description: For restrictions and removals: how to appeal

quantity.description: Initial available quantity; recorded in inventory as 'Initial stock'

publish.description: Publish immediately when the product is purchasable; otherwise saved as draft

stockItemId.description: Existing company stock item; omitted = create one at the default warehouse

condition.description: Draft only; afterwards end the offer and create a new one

price.description: Sellers only; Official Store prices change through price-changes

confirmLargeChange.description: The seller confirms a price change above largeSellerPriceChangePct. Without it such a PATCH returns LARGE_PRICE_CHANGE_UNCONFIRMED (details.offers) and nothing is saved; with it the change applies like any other edit.

windowDays.description: Required for extended; at least the category baseline

label.description: e.g. 'Free delivery Thu, Oct 15' or 'Arrives Fri, Oct 16 – Mon, Oct 19'

freeOver.description: Free-shipping threshold for this seller, if any

orderWithinMinutes.description: Countdown to the cutoff that keeps this date

quantity.description: Shown when low (e.g. '9 left') or to the seller

maxPerOrder.description: min(available, purchase limit); drives the quantity selector

price.description: Price the customer pays now: the campaign price from promotions.priceOffers when a markdown or flash sale applies, else the offer price

regularPrice.description: Offer price when a campaign price applies (shown separately when deal stock ends)

automaticDiscount.description: Seller or platform discount the customer qualifies for without a code (from promotions)

total.description: Item price + shipping − automatic discount, before tax. The comparable total.

ineligibleNote.description: Shown under ineligible offers on the all-offers page

wasPriceRule.description: From promotions, e.g. 'Was price is the seller's lowest price in the 30 days before Oct 6'

taxNote.description: 'Totals include shipping; sales tax is added at checkout.'

selectedBy.description: customer_choice keeps the seller the customer picked; never switched silently

featured.description: Present when the customer chose a different offer, so both are visible

summary.description: e.g. '$189.00 · In stock' or '2 offers from $184.00'

title.description: e.g. 'Out of stock at the Official Store'

expectedRestockDate.description: From inventory incoming stock; stated as an estimate

alternatives.description: Other sellers' offers for the same variant

returnBaseline.description: Category baseline the terms must meet

productReviewState.description: From catalog; shown as a separate column

reviewNote.description: Reviewer reason when changes were requested on the seller's own product

contentGaps.description: Missing product content shown under the name (e.g. 'Missing images and identifiers'); empty when complete

endsAt.description: Price reverts to the previous price at this time (e.g. end of an event)

reason.description: Required; recorded in action history

marginBeforePct.description: Official Store only, from inventory unit cost

expiresAt.description: Preview must be applied before this; prices may have moved after

message.description: What is wrong and how to fix it, e.g. 'Price $2.40 is below the $5.00 minimum for Cables and adapters. Did you mean $24.00?'

unitCost.description: Weighted average buying cost from inventory

note.description: e.g. 'Incoming 120 on PUR-2610-0042' or 'Product changes requested'

appealRoute.description: Defaults to the seller appeal route from sellers

text.description: Published wording, linked from the store and Seller rules

minOnTimeDispatchPct.description: Seller on-time dispatch at or above this over the window

deliveryDayAdjustmentPct.description: Added to the total, as % of item price, per business day slower than the fastest eligible offer

competingConditions.description: Conditions that compete by default, e.g. ['new']; others compete only within their condition filter

adjustedTotal.description: Total + delivery adjustment used for ranking

kind.description: One change per line, checked in this order: removed, seller_restricted, availability, delivery, price, terms (terms only when the price did not change)

before.description: Display text of the old value: price '$94.99', availability the quantity asked for ('3'), terms 'v2'; null for delivery, removed and seller_restricted. Read previous for the typed value.

after.description: Display text of the new value: price '$99.99', availability the units that can be bought now ('1', '0'), delivery the location label that is not served, terms 'v3'; null for removed and seller_restricted. Read current for the typed value.

previous.description: Typed old value, by kind: price → price (the line's price), availability → quantity (asked for), terms → termsVersion (the line's). Null for delivery, removed and seller_restricted

current.description: Typed new value, by kind: price → price (now), availability → quantity (units that can be bought now, 0 when the offer is not active), delivery → postalCode (the location not served), terms → termsVersion (now). Null for removed and seller_restricted

alternatives.description: Other offers for the same variant the customer may choose explicitly

sellerSku.description: Seller's own code (Official Store: company SKU) at purchase, for packing slips, seller order search and exports

title.description: Offer title at purchase (product title with variant label)

price.description: Offer (regular) price at purchase. Campaign markdowns, flash prices, coupons and automatic discounts are not in it: the price the customer paid per unit comes from checkout (promotions evaluation) on the order item.

id.description: Seller id; null for the Official Store

email.description: Contact email (a valid address on createOrder). Order reads for staff without orders.customers.view-contact show it masked (a***@example.com), so it is a plain string; sellers never see it

sellerSku.description: Shown to the seller and staff only

summary.description: e.g. '30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping for change of mind.'

policyVersionId.description: content policy version in force at purchase

refundStatus.description: Mirrored from returns and payments; 'approved' is never shown as money arrived

categoryId.description: Product category at purchase (from the catalog snapshot); finance uses it for category fee rates

stateNote.description: e.g. 'Not shipped yet. You can cancel it until Casa Verde ships it.'

splitFromItemId.description: Set when a partial cancel, shipment or return split the line

checkoutLineId.description: Checkout session line the item came from (OrderItemInput.checkoutLineId); checkout maps its lines to order items by it, not by offer id. Split lines keep it; replacement lines have none

actions.description: What the viewer can do now

fundedBy.description: Who pays the shipping when it is free to the customer

statusLabel.description: 'Shipped, tracking pending' until a carrier scan; never implies delivery

handlingNote.description: 'Official Store item. Marketly handles returns.' or 'Casa Verde Home handles this package. Marketly support can step in.'

note.description: e.g. 'Visa •••• 4417 charged Sep 14. No refunds sent yet.'

value.description: Derived from the items; see notes

addressNote.description: 'To change where a package goes, contact the seller before it ships. Address book changes don't affect this order.'

policyVersions.description: Policy versions accepted at purchase (returns, shipping, purchase terms), from content.currentPolicyVersions at placement

reason.description: 'Not shipped yet. Free to cancel.' or 'Already shipped. You can return it after delivery.'

cutoffRule.description: 'You can cancel an item until its seller marks it shipped.'

discountShare.description: Coupon share deducted (coupons are split across items by value)

timingNote.description: 'Refunds are sent within 1 business day of confirmation; banks usually show them 3–5 business days after they are sent.'

statusNote.description: 'Requested means no money has moved yet.'

respondBy.description: Seller confirmation deadline for customer requests

id.description: Seller group id (the seller's fulfillment task)

buyerName.description: First name and last initial, e.g. 'Sam R.'

deadlineLabel.description: 'Due today 5:00 PM', 'Overdue 3 h', 'Shipped Oct 6 · 1 day late'

platformFeeEstimate.description: From finance.calculateFee when finance is on

earningsNote.description: 'Earnings stay pending until delivery and the hold period end.'

mixedOrderNote.description: 'The customer's order also has items from other sellers. You only see and handle your own items.'

shipTo.description: Full address and phone for the carrier, only while the task is open plus the return window

owner.description: Who handles the overdue group (warehouse, seller or a named manager)

marketplaceFee.description: From finance; null for Official Store (company sales)

history.description: Staff action history with names and reasons (latest 20; full list via timeline endpoint)

count.description: Current match count, refreshed every 5 minutes

attemptNo.description: Payment attempt that this order belongs to (default 1). createOrder is idempotent per (checkoutSessionId, attemptNo); checkout passes the next number when the customer retries after a pending payment was finally declined

reservationId.description: Checkout's inventory stock hold for this order; carried on orders.order.accepted so inventory can allocate from it

deliveryAddressId.description: Saved customer address the delivery address came from (customers module); null for guests and one-off addresses

visitorId.description: Visitor id of the shopper's app session, set only when the shopper allowed personalization (advertising attributes guest orders to ad clicks by it). Null otherwise

policyVersions.description: From content.currentPolicyVersions(['returns', 'shipping', 'purchase_terms']) read by checkout at placement; empty when content is off

paymentState.description: The authorize result: accepted when the payment is already authorized (or nothing is left to pay by card), pending_check only when the provider is still checking

label.description: 'Visa •••• 4417'; kept on the payment even if the saved method is removed

providerToken.description: Single-use token from the provider's card fields or wallet sheet; card numbers never reach Marketly

amount.description: The whole order total, store-credit share included. The card is authorized for amount − creditAmount

creditHoldId.description: wallet hold of the store-credit share (checkout holds it before authorizing)

creditAmount.description: Store-credit share of amount (the wallet hold); null or absent when no credit is used. Must not exceed amount; when it equals amount nothing is authorized on the card

returnUrl.description: Where the provider sends the customer back after a bank challenge

message.description: Customer-safe text: 'Your bank declined Visa •••• 4417. Nothing was charged.'

state.description: Customer view: Accepted, Pending (being checked), Failed

message.description: Pending: 'We're confirming your payment with your bank. Don't pay again.'

holdNote.description: 'Your bank may show a temporary hold for $429.98. Placing the order again could create a second hold.'

label.description: Customer's name for it, e.g. 'Work Mastercard'

chargeNote.description: 'Your card is charged once, when the order is accepted. Each seller is paid by Marketly after delivery.'

amount.description: Card amount captured; 0 for a credit-only capture (store credit alone paid the order or group, no provider call)

creditAmount.description: Store-credit share charged with this capture; null when no credit was used

operation.description: partial_void lowers an authorization when the adapter supports it; dispute_* calls are logged against the dispute's intent

orphan.description: Authorized or captured with no order after orphanGraceMinutes

inFlight.description: Requested, processing and failed refunds: a failed refund keeps reserving its amount (it may still be retried or sent to a new destination) until it is sent or cancelled, so no second refund can take the same money

blockedReason.description: e.g. 'In transit: refund after delivery or a confirmed loss'

inFlight.description: Requested, processing and failed refunds (a failed refund reserves its amount until sent or cancelled)

remaining.description: Captured less refunded and in flight

ref.description: RF-YYMMDD-NNNN (the returns request reference when handed over by returns)

orderId.description: The order refunded; for an orphan payment refund (money without an order) the checkout session id, as on the refund events (refunds.order_id is null then)

checkoutSessionId.description: Checkout session of the payment refunded

customerName.description: Customer on the payment (customers profile name, or the guest email for guest orders); shown in the admin failing-refunds table

lastAttemptAt.description: When the latest provider attempt (send, retry or status check) was made; 'why it failed' shows method and this time

outcomeUnknown.description: Provider did not answer; the next step is a status check, never a resend

arrivalNote.description: 'Card refunds usually arrive 3–5 business days after we send them.'

explanation.description: 'Sent means we've sent it to your bank; it usually shows in 3–5 business days.'

ref.description: CB-YYMMDD-NNNN for chargebacks, DP- for wallet or provider disputes

reason.description: 'Item not received (card issuer)'

sellerBalanceEffect.description: What the dispute does to the seller balance, worded by payments from the dispute status and the group owner (finance applies it on payments.chargeback.opened and decided; payments does not read finance): seller group open 'Held $480.00', won 'Hold of $480.00 released', lost '$480.00 deducted from the seller balance'; Official Store 'Company sale. A loss is recorded in company trading.'; no single group 'Not linked to one seller. Finance decides who carries the loss.'

timeZone.description: IANA zone the campaign was set up in, e.g. America/Los_Angeles. Countdowns use startsAt/endsAt exactly.

amountOff.description: Fixed amount off (per order for coupons, per unit for markdowns)

minSpendScope.description: What the minimum spend is measured on

exclude.description: Exclusions, e.g. clearance items, a restricted seller, a product under review

regions.description: Region codes within the service region, e.g. CA, OR

newCustomerRule.description: Shown to customers, e.g. first order on Marketly

budget.description: Campaign stops when the discount cost reaches it

perOrder.description: Codes of this campaign per order: empty or 1. A campaign applies at most once per order (a second code of the same campaign is rejected with per_order_limit); a value above 1 is refused with VALIDATION_FAILED

perCustomerUnits.description: Purchase limit in units (markdowns, flash sales)

platformShareBps.description: Platform share of the discount on seller offers when shared, e.g. 5000

note.description: Funding note for Finance (column campaigns.funding_note), e.g. Official Store items: the discount is a company cost shown in company trading margin

exclusiveGroup.description: Campaigns in the same group never combine

rules.description: Eligibility shown to sellers, e.g. Offer rating 4.0 or higher, At least 20 units in stock, No price increase in the last 30 days

description.description: Customer-facing one-liner, e.g. 20% off bedding and lighting

code.description: Shared code, e.g. FALLHOME20. Omit for automatic discounts.

autoApply.description: Authoritative (decision P1): true = applied automatically to every eligible cart, with or without the code; false = applied only through its code or, for signed-in customers, a clip. A campaign with no code and autoApply false is clip-only. Default false.

terms.description: Public terms shown on the Deals page, campaign page and coupon

checks.description: e.g. budget above the Marketing limit, platform share does not reduce seller proceeds, seller share matches consent, cost center balance

officialMarginImpactPts.description: Official Store margin change in percentage points, e.g. -3.1

feeBasis.description: Price after the seller-funded part; platform-funded part is not deducted

explanation.description: e.g. On a $100.00 sale at 20% off with shared funding: the customer pays $80.00 …

ineligibleReasons.description: e.g. Needs at least 20 units in stock (you have 12)

consentText.description: Exact text the seller agreed to, kept with the record

featuredOn.description: e.g. Home page, Deals page, Opening ad

leavePolicy.description: e.g. You can leave before Oct 12. After it starts, leaving needs Marketing approval.

salesNote.description: Historical context; never a promise of sales

combinesWithPlatformCoupons.description: The platform-funded part never comes from the seller

discountLabel.description: The rule in words for the Your discounts table, e.g. 10% off, $5 off, Free shipping over $75

offers.description: Offers covered, with customer price and earnings per unit

regularOffer.description: When the deal sells out, the regular offer is shown separately

sales.description: Sales of promoted items (recorded separately from discount cost)

marginImpactPts.description: Official Store margin change on promoted items, landed-cost basis

storeReturnsPct.description: Store-wide return rate for the same range, from reports when enabled; null when not available (never 0 as a stand-in)

price.description: Price after markdown or flash price

wasPrice.description: Reference price, lowest in the look-back window

sellerPromos.description: e.g. 10% off orders over $100 from Northwind Audio, applied automatically

automaticDiscount.description: Per-unit discount the customer gets without doing anything (running autoApply coupon campaigns for everyone, or every signed-in customer when signed in, e.g. an automatic 10% off), on top of price. A minimum spend counts when one unit at price reaches it; category and brand scopes are matched from catalog (getProducts). Offers subtracts it in comparable totals for the featured-offer rule (Total price = item + shipping − automatic discounts). Null when none

conditions.description: e.g. Casa Verde Home · minimum spend $100 · one use per customer

secondsLeft.description: Computed from endsAt and serverTime; clients count down from it

rules.description: e.g. Coupons can't be combined with flash sale prices unless the coupon says so. One coupon per seller per order.

sellerId.description: The seller id, or OFFICIAL_STORE_ID for Official Store lines. Defensive: evaluateCart maps '' or null to OFFICIAL_STORE_ID when officialStore is true (VALIDATION_FAILED otherwise), so redemption_lines.seller_id is always a uuid

categoryId.description: Null when the caller does not know it (catalog off); category-scoped campaigns then do not match the line

contactEmail.description: Guest checkout contact email. Per-customer limits and new-customer eligibility for guests key on its normalised hash (usage_counters.customer_key), so one person cannot reuse a one-per-customer coupon by checking out as a new guest. Ignored when customerId is set

codes.description: Codes entered by the customer; clipped coupons of a signed-in customer are added automatically

shipping.description: packageId → shipping charge, for free-shipping evaluation

discountedQuantity.description: Units that get the deal price (decision P2). Quantity above the remaining per-customer or deal limit is split: discountedQuantity units at unitPrice, the rest at regularUnitPrice, limitExceeded true. Equals the line quantity when nothing is over the limit

reason.description: budget_insufficient: the remaining budget does not cover the whole discount for this cart; nothing is applied (decision P3, never a partial discount)

message.description: e.g. Applies only to Home & Kitchen items from the Official Store. None in your cart qualify.

skipped.description: Automatic or clipped campaigns that matched but were not applied, with a reason the customer can read

changes.description: Differences from the previous evaluation, e.g. HOMEWEEK10 ended at 12:00 PM PT

location.description: City and region, e.g. 'Los Angeles, CA'

onTimePct.description: Deliveries arriving within the window, last 90 days

returnAuthorizationRequired.description: The supplier needs a return authorization (RMA) before units are sent back (getPreferredSupplier tells inventory and returns)

preferred.description: Preferred supplier for this SKU (used by reorder suggestions)

lineExpectedDates.description: Line id → new expected date (allowed after sending)

approval.description: Set when the total is above the buyer's purchase limit (e.g. $25,000)

avgDailySales.description: From inventory.getSalesRate over the last 30 days

date.description: Receiving day in the location's time zone (default today)

arrivedNotReceived.description: Deliveries in status arrived (at the dock, receiving not started)

receivedThisWeek.description: Deliveries received (with or without issues) since the start of the week

openShortages.description: Receipt lines with a shortage or damage not yet covered by a settled or rejected supplier claim

shortageOwner.description: Purchasing owner following up (open claim owner, else the purchase order buyer); shown as 'with Ken Watanabe'

reason.description: Why the window or status changed; shown on the receiving screen

confirmedBy.description: Inventory Manager who made the units sellable

supplierReference.description: The supplier's own reference for the claim, given when it is sent (submitClaim)

key.description: e.g. commerce.gross_sales

definition.description: Plain-language meaning shown under every report that uses it

formula.description: How it is computed from read-model facts

currencyRule.description: e.g. reporting currency USD; one currency at launch

timeZone.description: e.g. America/Los_Angeles; days run 00:00–23:59 market time

relatedKeys.description: e.g. gross sales ↔ sales after cancellations and refunds; marketplace sales ↔ marketplace fee income

launchMeasure.description: Part of the small launch set (plan ch. 19)

owner.description: Named owner; null until someone is named (seeded metrics start without one). Publishing needs an owner (OWNER_REQUIRED)

ownerId.description: Staff member who owns the metric; may be named later (PUT /metrics/{key}/owner)

key.description: e.g. commerce.sales

dimensions.description: e.g. day, sold_by, seller, category, product, reason, placement

layout.description: Blocks the screen draws: kpis, series, split, table, breakdown, definitions, callouts

owner.description: Named owner of the group; null until someone is named

ownerRole.description: Role expected to own it, e.g. Finance Manager (shown while no person is named)

delta.description: { value, unit: pct|pts, direction: up|down, good: bool } vs the comparison period

meta.description: { reportKey, title, range, dateBasis, currency, timeZone, taxIncluded, freshAsOf, mayStillChange, definitionsVersion, compareRange?, scope: platform|seller }

split.description: { label, amount: Money, sharePct } e.g. Official Store vs marketplace sellers

table.description: { columns: [{ key, label, unit, align }], rows: json[], totals: json }

callouts.description: { kind: info|warning, title, body } e.g. 'Marketplace sales are not marketplace fee income'

recipients.description: Staff only (decision D2); each must hold the report's group permission

key.description: Every dataset a screen can export. See the exportDatasets setting for owner, permission, audience and screens.
An ExportDatasetKey value

owner.description: Module that supplies the rows through its publicApi exportRows

permission.description: Dataset permission, checked in addition to reports.exports.create (staff) or by itself (seller)

columns.description: { key, label, permission? } — columns with a permission are dropped for callers without it

screens.description: Screens whose Export button uses it

available.description: False while the owner module is disabled (the Export button is hidden)

columnsExcluded.description: Columns removed because of the caller's permissions

sha256.description: Checksum of the finished file, so a downloaded export (e.g. audit entries) can be checked for changes

error.description: Why a failed job failed, e.g. More than 100,000 rows matched; narrow the filters (EXPORT_TOO_LARGE)

dataset.description: An ExportDatasetKey value; omit when exporting a report (reportKey)

dateBasis.description: Gross sales by order placement date

kpis.description: Gross sales, orders (with AOV), marketplace fee income (on seller sales), refunds (share of gross)

salesSplit.description: { series: Series[] (official, marketplace; last 14 days), official: Money, marketplace: Money, officialSharePct }

dispatchDeadlines.description: Most urgent first: { orderId, orderRef, placedAt, buyerLabel, itemsLabel, deadline: Deadline, nextAction }

sales.description: { range, gross: Money, deltaPct, orders, averageOrder: Money, today: Money, todayOrders, series: Series[], basis: 'item sales before fees, by order date' }

payouts.description: From finance: { pending, available, held: Money, nextPayout: { date, amount, destinationLabel }, isExampleSchedule }

performance.description: From sellers: dispatch reliability, cancellation rate and response time vs targets

announcements.description: From content: { title, body, kind, effectiveFrom?, link }

rebuildable.description: False for read models kept from events only (refunds, returns, service): there is no event log to replay yet, so rebuild is refused

failure.description: Why an approved correction could not be applied (e.g. the customer no longer has the credit to take away)

message.description: Shown on the handheld, e.g. 'Not on this pick list'

deliveryChoice.description: Service the customer chose, e.g. 'UPS Ground · arrives Tue, Oct 13'

holdReason.description: e.g. 'Shortage reported: bin F-12-3 empty. Inventory is checking.'

dispatchOverdueAt.description: When shipping reported the dispatch deadline missed (shipping.dispatch.overdue); the order then leads the pick list

mixedOrderNote.description: e.g. 'This order also has Package 2 of 2 from Pixel & Port. They ship it separately.'

orders.description: Pick list grouped by order, lines in walking order by bin

itemCode.description: Scanned item barcode (GTIN or SKU label)

serialNumbers.description: Serials captured at packing for serialized items

index.description: Package number within the whole order (all sellers)

carrierServiceId.description: Shipping carrier service chosen at packing (PackageUpdate.serviceCode); the label is bought with it

serviceCode.description: Only services that keep the customer's promised delivery date

arrivesBy.description: Latest estimated arrival if the package leaves today

keepsPromise.description: Arrives within the date range promised to the customer at checkout; services that do not are listed but cannot be chosen (SERVICE_BREAKS_PROMISE)

matchesCustomerChoice.description: The service of the delivery option the customer chose

rate.description: Label cost for this box and weight; empty until dimensions and weight are set

unexpected.description: Parcel with no approved return; support is told

code.description: Return reference, tracking number or return label barcode

atRisk.description: Not packed and ship-by within the at-risk window

shipToday.description: All packages with ship-by today, any stage

label.description: e.g. Lowest in 30 days; Typical price $139–$165; Same price for 30 days

alerts.description: Toggle state shown on the item card

condition.description: e.g. Any drop below $329.00; Olive, from Trailhead Outfitters

armedAt.description: Back-in-stock alerts: when the item was seen unavailable, so a restock can fire the alert. Null while the item has stayed in stock since the alert was switched on. Price-drop alerts: the creation time

deliveryNote.description: e.g. Alerts arrive as notifications and email. Turn alerts off any time. These are separate from order updates.

afterMinutes.description: Minutes after the deadline (0 = at the deadline)

to.description: { kind: role|staff, key or staffId, name }

condition.description: Optional rule, e.g. 'seller items only', 'amount over $1,000'

key.description: Stable key, e.g. shipping.overdue_dispatch

escalationLabel.description: Readable route, e.g. 'Seller Manager (sellers), Business Owner after 48 h'

businessHoursOnly.description: Deadlines count market business hours from settings

pauseWhileWaiting.description: While an item waits on someone outside the team (seller, customer, carrier, supplier) its deadline clock stops; on resume dueAt moves later by the time spent waiting. False: waiting keeps the deadline

screen.description: Prototype screen where the work is done, e.g. ops/dispatch

key.description: Create only (ignored on update: a queue's key never changes). Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores in two dot-separated parts, e.g. inventory.cycle_counts; 409 CONFLICT when taken. Omitted: derived as <area>.<name slug> (name lowercased, every run of other characters becomes _, at most 48 characters), with _2, _3… appended while that key is taken

oldest.description: { itemId, subjectRef, openedAt, ageLabel } e.g. MK-260914-48213 · 16 d

mine.description: I lead it, back it up or have items assigned in it

kind.description: What kind of work; how each kind closes is in the notes

relatedSubjects.description: Other records the item's actions use, e.g. the delivery_exception of an overdue_dispatch item (Remind seller calls POST /api/admin/shipping/exceptions/{id}/notify-seller with its id)

escalationLevel.description: 0 = not escalated; n = step n of the route reached

links.description: { label, screen, state? } e.g. Open order → admin/order

archived.description: Resolved more than itemRetentionDays ago; left out of lists unless archived=true

kind.description: One of the work item kinds

sourceModule.description: The calling module (stored as items.source_module and shown on the item); required

resolvesOn.description: Events that close the item, e.g. shipping.shipment.dispatched

target.description: work_items filters this module's list; screen stores a filter for another module's list screen

filters.description: Query parameters as saved, e.g. { queueKey, overdueOver: '24h', sellerKind: 'marketplace' }

count.description: Current matching open items (work_items filters only)

source.description: workqueues, finance, advertising/promotions, warehouse/shipping; 'unavailable' when the module is off

checkedIn.description: For shared checks: { done: int, total: int } e.g. 3 of 4 managers checked in

stats.description: { assignedToMe, queuesILead, overdue, overdueChangeVsYesterday, oldestOpen: { ref, ageLabel } }

reminders.description: e.g. escalation reminder and export scope

needsAttention.description: { queueKey, name, areaLabel, count, overdue, tone: danger|warning|neutral, oldestLabel, screen, screenFilter }

overdueDispatch.description: Top overdue and at-risk dispatch items for the dashboard table

bearer.description: Bearer <token> on every request: visitor token before sign-in, access token after (customer, seller member or staff)

refreshCookie.name: __Secure-mk_refresh
refreshCookie.description: Website refresh token (HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api/public/identity/sessions, sent only to refresh and sign-out). Android sends refreshToken in the body instead.

appProof.name: X-App-Proof
appProof.description: Bootstrap only: Play Integrity token (Android) or bot-challenge token (website)
